thread:
Aisha K: quick flag from the release smoke run: the embeddings guide on staging is rendering an embedded Gist that now 500s when the page loads. that breaks the smoke snapshot and the CI check for docs-build.

docs-bot: external-link-check: https://gist.github.com/redwood/old-embed -> 500 (staging)

Tom B: ugh, that gist was deleted during the repo cleanup last month. are we embedding raw gist HTML or using the legacy gist block? either way we should remove the embed and inline the minimal example to avoid external deps in the build.

Aisha K: agreed — for the release I just want the page to build and the smoke to pass. can someone do a quick PR to replace the embed with a fenced code block copy of the gist? later we can migrate to the shared snippets system.

Leo M: I can take this. plan: 1) add inline snippet to docs/kb/embeddings/usage.md 2) open PR with small test snapshot update 3) create infra ticket to update any other pages referencing that gist.

Tom B: ping me on the PR, Ill review. quick sed I used to find other embeds:

```
rg "gist.github.com" docs/ --hidden
```
and to replace a gist-embed with a fenced block locally I did:

```
# copy the gist contents into the page
awk 'FNR==1{print "```python"} {print} END{print "```"}' snippet.py > tmp-block.md
rg -l "gist.github.com/redwood/old-embed" docs/ | xargs -I{} sed -i "s@<script src=\"https://gist.github.com/redwood/old-embed.js\"></script>@$(cat tmp-block.md)@g" {}
```
Leo M: noted. I'll avoid committing tmp files; will paste the fenced block in the PR. creating the ticket for infra so we can rehost the canonical snippet under our assets if needed: https://infra.redwood.ai/tickets/2412

oncall-bot: reminder: docs publishing deploy window tomorrow 09:00-09:30 PT; if this needs an emergency hotfix outside the window, tag `oncall` in the PR.

Aisha K: thanks Leo. when you open the PR can you add a one-liner to the changelog and mark it as "docs:hotfix" so release knows to include the build?

Leo M: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/12942 (WIP). title: "docs: replace deleted gist embed with inline example to fix build". assigned to Tom for review. I'll also add the infra ticket link in the PR body.

docs-bot: created issue docs:replace-embed-2412, assigned to Leo M, label "docs:hotfix"

Tom B: lgtm, will review in ~30m. if it's green and small we can merge before the deploy window.

Aisha K: awesome, thanks everyone :raised_hands: will follow up in standup if anything blocks.
